$comment: ledger.firstSeenRows and ledger.headMoveInvalidation default true. Open-head observations use the existing ledger writer and lock; each effective value and source is logged. Acceptance labels alone never grant an imported clearance. Set false to disable the respective observation writer. Completed reviews still witness fresh heads, and a fresh review at a new head still ends the old head's approvals and exemptions with the switch off; delayed verdicts for superseded heads stay historical, and readers check acceptance coverage against the live head. ledger.drainObserveMaxPerPass (default 20) and ledger.drainObserveBudgetMs (default 15000) cap the drain pass's live head observations by count and wall time; the budget is also each read's and write's deadline, and anything skipped or failed is one logged ledger-write-miss retried next pass.
